episode_title: Too Big To Fail: Season 2 Episode 5 | From Cleats to Cowboy Boots with Jacob Jackson

real_qa.q: What was Jacob Jackson's career path before joining Moss Utilities?
real_qa.r: Jacob worked as a regional sales associate at an investment firm in Plano, Texas, which correlated with his college degree. Before moving to Texas, he worked at Jack Surfboards in Dana Point, California, where he sold surfboards, clothing, and provided servicing such as installing new fins. He handled retail and customer sales across ocean-related sports including surfing, skating, and snowboarding.
real_qa.requete: Jacob Jackson career before Moss Utilities

real_qa.q: Why did Jacob Jackson move from California to Dallas, Texas?
real_qa.r: Jacob and his fiancée Silver decided to relocate because the price of living in California was not worth it for them. They were both finishing college and wanted to find and build careers in a different state, preferably one without state income tax. Silver's family was originally from San Antonio with two siblings living in the Dallas area at the time, which provided them a connection point.
real_qa.requete: Why move from California to Dallas Texas

real_qa.q: What was Jacob Jackson's first experience in Moss Utilities onboarding process?
real_qa.r: Jacob's first experience with Moss U involved completing a training course, which he found super helpful for learning about heavy equipment, heavy machinery, and working in the trenches before being sent to the field. After training, he began in the pre-construction or estimating department, followed by a transition to project management, and then moved out to field operations.
real_qa.requete: Moss Utilities Moss U onboarding training process

real_qa.q: How did working in the field change Jacob Jackson's perspective on construction work?
real_qa.r: Working in pre-construction as a project manager going out to the field was eye-opening for Jacob. He realized how appreciative he was for what the workers do in the trenches, as he found himself sweating, out of breath, and needing breaker breaks despite thinking he was in shape. He observed workers going non-stop and recognized he had taken their work for granted before experiencing it firsthand.
real_qa.requete: field work appreciation construction workers perspective

real_qa.q: What was Jacob Jackson's family background regarding sports and career influence?
real_qa.r: Jacob's upbringing was dominated by his English father's influence, making everything soccer-related—every weekend featured soccer games rather than baseball or football. His father was born in Sheffield, England, and worked as a sales manager for sports companies including Nike, Umbro, and New Balance. Jacob was invited to play for West Ham's youth academy in London at age 10 and traveled there multiple times, though he eventually decided not to pursue professional soccer.
real_qa.requete: Jacob Jackson West Ham soccer family background England

real_qa.q: How did Jacob Jackson's early work experience at Jack Surfboards prepare him for retail and customer service?
real_qa.r: At Jack Surfboards in Dana Point, California, Jacob handled everything from selling surfboards and clothing to servicing equipment with new fins and related items. Despite having surfed only once in his life (boogie boarding on whitewash at San Onofre), he used sales tactics and customer engagement skills even though he lacked personal surfing experience, selling to customers who were far more knowledgeable than him.
real_qa.requete: Jack Surfboards Dana Point retail experience

guest.titre: Pre-Construction Project Manager / Project Manager / Field Operations
guest.bio_context: Jacob Jackson was born and raised in Temecula, California, north of San Diego, until age 24 when he relocated to Dallas, Texas in 2024. He attended the same high school as his fiancée Silver but met her through a mutual friend after both had moved away to separate colleges. Before joining Moss Utilities around July 2020, he worked as a regional sales associate at an investment firm in Plano that aligned with his college degree, and previously worked at Jack Surfboards in Dana Point, Orange County, California, handling sales, servicing, and customer interaction across ocean-related sports retail.
